svg.title: Daily Orders pipeline: Olist to a ClickHouse star schema
svg.desc: Olist CSVs from Kaggle seed a Postgres Shop Database and an Excel Merchandising Catalog. Python extracts one Business Date and loads it unchanged into ClickHouse Bronze. dbt builds Silver (typed and checked, bad rows to the Quarantine) and a Gold star schema with a daily Revenue by Product Category view, used by dashboards, ad-hoc SQL, reports and ML features. Airflow runs it daily at 00:00 WIB, everything runs in Docker Compose, and pytest tests it.
svg.text: From an e-commerce shop to a ClickHouse star schema
One Business Date per run · ELT with Python, dbt and Airflow · checked against the source every time
a rerun replaces only its day
Every load kept in Bronze for audit
SQL models move data through the
Bad rows go to the Quarantine
with a reason; the run continues
Unique and not-null tests each build
dimensions run one at a time
